camel_example: aliyun ossutil api put-live-channel-status --bucket examplebucket --channel exmplechannel --region cn-hangzhou --status enabled
description_en: Switches a LiveChannel between the enabled and disabled states
description_zh: 切换LiveChannel启用（enabled）和禁用（disabled）两种状态
name: PutLiveChannelStatus

parameters.help_en: The LiveChannel name. The LiveChannel must exist
parameters.name: channel

parameters.help_en:
The status of the LiveChannel.

Valid values:
enabled: enables the LiveChannel
disabled: disables the LiveChannel
parameters.help_zh:
设置LiveChannel的Status。
有效值：
enabled：启用LiveChannel
disabled：禁用LiveChannel
parameters.name: status
